segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מְנָחוֹת הָיוּ נִקְמָצוֹת בְּכׇל מָקוֹם בָּעֲזָרָה, וְנֶאֱכָלוֹת לִפְנִים מִן הַקְּלָעִים – לְזִכְרֵי כְהוּנָּה, בְּכׇל מַאֲכָל, לְיוֹם וָלַיְלָה עַד חֲצוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Handfuls were removed from the meal offerings in any place in the» Temple «courtyard and were consumed within» the area enclosed by «the curtains by males of the priesthood,» prepared «in any» form of «food» preparation that he chooses, e.g., roasted or boiled, «for» one «day and night, until midnight.»

moves.cueHe: מנחות היו נקמצות בכל מקום בעזרה
moves.summary: The mishna rules on the place of kemitza and the eating of meal offerings.

positions.claim: meal offerings have their handful removed anywhere in the courtyard and are eaten within the curtains by male priests, in any preparation, for a day and night until midnight
